introduction.name: Lathiesh Mahendran
introduction.title: AI & Full-Stack Engineer
introduction.headline: I build AI-powered products, from the data pipeline to the user interface.
introduction.description: I'm a product engineer at Corvus, with 3+ years of experience building at early-stage startups. My work spans AI agents, retrieval systems, backend services, and full-stack applications.

about: I'm Lathiesh, an AI and full-stack engineer based in Coimbatore. I've worked closely with founders and small engineering teams, taking products from initial requirements through architecture, implementation, and production support.

At Corvus, I build research agents, company enrichment pipelines, evaluation tooling, and product features for sales intelligence. Previously, at The Yellow Network, I co-built Tia, a RAG assistant for TVS Supply Chain Solutions, and Nifo, an AI co-innovation platform.
I enjoy owning a problem end to end: understanding the data, choosing the right approach, building the experience, and improving it once it's in use.

projects.name: Corvus
projects.subtitle: AI research and company intelligence
projects.summary: Architected a multi-step research pipeline that turns a company name into a cited report on its products, facilities, and operations.
projects.problem: Chemical-industry sales research requires information about companies, their products, and their facilities to be collected and brought together into useful account intelligence.
myContribution: Architected tool-using research agents with parallel, resumable stages on Trigger.dev.
Engineered enrichment and classification pipelines across a dataset of approximately 200,000 companies, including entity matching and deduplication.
Built evaluation harnesses using ground-truth datasets and precision/recall scoring.
Extended context management and state persistence in the agent harness and built MCP tools for EPA facility data.
Shipped full-stack features using FastAPI, Neon PostgreSQL, and React/TypeScript.
engineeringDecisions: Resume failed stages to avoid restarting the entire workflow.
Use prompt caching and models sized for individual stages to manage LLM cost.
Benchmark model and prompt changes before they reach production.

evidence.meaning: Companies in the enrichment/classification dataset, not customers or research reports
Evaluation measures used; no numeric scores supplied

projects.name: Tia
projects.subtitle: RAG assistant for TVS Supply Chain Solutions
projects.context: Co-built with one other engineer at The Yellow Network
projects.summary: Co-built a visitor-support assistant that answers questions and captures sales-qualified leads in HubSpot CRM.
projects.problem: Website visitors need relevant answers about the company's services, while sales enquiries need to reach the sales team.
myContribution: Co-built the assistant from scratch with one other engineer.
Designed the AWS Lambda, Pinecone, and AWS Bedrock architecture and tuned cold starts.
Combined semantic and targeted service queries using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
Built a 150-query retrieval evaluation suite and used failing queries to guide improvements.
engineeringDecisions: Combine complementary retrieval approaches rather than relying on one search path.
Use a fast model for metadata filters and a stronger model for answers.
Evaluate success rate, response latency, link relevance, and category coverage.

evidence.meaning: Size of the evaluation suite, not usage or an accuracy score
